newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start lower, buyers remain cautious.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start lower, buyers remain cautious.

text.p: European meals and feeds were offered into the physical market at up to six dollars lower on Friday after the weaker Chicago close but buyers remained cautious ahead of key USDA data due on Monday, traders said.
Bids were reported at prices around two to three dollars below those offered but there were no trades early on.
"Everyone is waiting for the USDA acreage figures, they will probably stay sidelined before then," one trader said.
Any demand seen today will be limited to nearby material as compounders are still betting on lower prices in the latter part of the year. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
